title: Rollout Beacon: trajectory & divergence navigator for per-route rollout investigations
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Objective: Ship a Console-first investigative surface (Rollout Beacon) that helps engineers and SREs rapidly understand why a canary or A/B variant is diverging and determine safe rollback or promote decisions. The Beacon will combine a compact trajectory timeline, per-route percentile/tail comparisons, trace-linked divergence highlights, and a mirrored-shadow diff inspector for traffic-replay comparisons.

Background: Teams currently rely on scattered charts (latency histograms, token cost, error rates) and manual trace lookups. During canaries we frequently spend 1-2 hours collecting data slices, replaying shadow traffic, and correlating traces before acting. Beacon aims to reduce that mean-time-to-decision to <15 minutes for typical regressions.

Scope and features (MVP):
- Trajectory timeline: stacked lane view showing key signals (p50/p90 latency, error rate, hallucination/regression score from evals) across rollout percentage changes. Ability to zoom to arbitrary window.
- Per-route delta view: side-by-side per-route time-series with percentage-delta overlays and significance shading. Includes request volume heatmap and top contributing endpoints.
- Shadow mirror diff inspector: allow operators to select a window and run a live diff between shadow vs live responses (sampling), with similarity scoring and token-level diff highlights.
- Trace linkage: for anomalous windows Beacon surfaces top N traces and enables one-click jump to tracing UI with same request ID + cohort tag.
- Anomaly scoring + suggested action: heuristic-based scoring to surface potential regressions and recommended actions (pause rollouts, route reassign, auto-rollback suggestion).

Non-goals (MVP): full replay engine, exhaustive token-level comparison for every request, or replacing existing deployment controls (Beacon will integrate with rollout controls, not reimplement them).

Acceptance criteria:
- Beacon surfaces the trajectory and per-route deltas for 90% of recent rollouts in staging and production.
- Operators can identify a top-3 likely causes (route, model variant, input spike) within 15 minutes in 80% of simulated regression playbooks.
- Shadow mirror inspector returns sampled diff summary within 60s for windows up to 10k requests.
- Tracing links open prefiltered trace view and include cohort metadata.

Instrumentation & data requirements:
- New telemetry: per-route p50/p90/p99, error counts by code, hallucination/regression score (from Optimize eval hooks), sample hashes for response diffing, cohort_id tagging on request and trace.
- Backend: ability to compute delta aggregations across arbitrary time ranges (windowed rollup service).
- Storage: short-term high-res metrics (1s-10s resolution) for last 48h plus aggregated rollups for 90d.

UX / design notes:
- Compact vertical lanes to compare signals without side-scrolling.
- Colorblind-safe divergence palette and significance stripes for p-values.
- Collapse/expand per-route rows; quick-filter by traffic slice, customer, or model variant.

Risks & trade-offs:
- Increased cardinality: per-route + per-variant metrics risk high cost; mitigate with sampling thresholds and on-demand rollups.
- Diffing privacy: token-level diffs could surface PII — enforce sampling rules and KMS-access gated diffs for private deployments.
- Auto-rollback accuracy: initial heuristics will be conservative; auto-rollback must be disabled by default and require explicit enable by SRE/owner.

Rollout plan:
- Week 1-2: Backend rollup API and telemetry schema landed (ENG).
- Week 3: Design/UX prototypes and internal testing with infra team.
- Week 4-5: Implement trajectory UI and per-route delta charts; wire trace links.
- Week 6: Shadow mirror inspector (sampling-based) + anomaly scoring.
- Week 7: Internal dogfood on simulated regressions; collect usability feedback.
- Week 8: Beta with two customers on Dedicated and Hosted; monitor usage and false-positive rates.

Success metrics:
- Reduce average time-to-decision in rollback playbook from 65 mins to <15 mins.
- Beacon adoption: used in 60% of rollouts within 30 days of GA.
- False-positive auto-suggestions <5% in beta.

Links and artifacts: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Rollout+Beacon+PRD, https://figma.com/file/Redwood/Rollout-Beacon-frames, https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pulls?q=is%3Apr+rollout-beacon
